reasoning: 驗證目標：可接收電台數量多於清單長度上限時，清單收錄的是接收品質最高的那些電台。關鍵情境條件：電台數量超過上限，且各電台的接收品質有明確可控的高低分佈——被排除的必須是品質最低的那些，才能區分「依品質取捨」與「依頻率先到先得」的實作（§7）。為什麼這樣切：一條 TC 覆蓋單一觸發（超出上限）的必然結果——高品質者入列、低品質者出列，依 §5.7 併為多條 ER。依 §8.2.1 與兄弟 leaf 劃界：上限數量本身由 072 覆蓋，相同 PI code 的去重由 071 覆蓋（其判準為場強，作用於同一電台的多個頻率），本 leaf 的判準作用於不同電台之間。刻意略過：接收品質的量測定義（場強、訊雜比或其他）未在條文中指定，ER 因此以「品質較高／較低」的相對關係描述，不寫具體門檻值（§8.4.1）。

tcs.tc_title: Stations with the best reception fill the list when it overflows
tcs.test_item: If more stations than the maximum length of the station list are available, the station list shall contain those stations with highest reception quality
tcs.pre_conditions:
1. An FM/AM signal generator is ready
2. The HU Tuner source is selected on the Cabin Output Channel
3. The HU is in FM analog tuner mode
4. The station list screen is displayed
tcs.input_test_data:
Group H: 50 receivable stations broadcast at a high reception quality
Group L: 5 further receivable stations broadcast at a reception quality clearly below every station of group H, on frequencies interleaved with them
tcs.test_procedure:
1. Set the signal generator to broadcast the stations of group H and group L
2. Start the station list update from the refresh softkey
3. Read the entries on the station list once the update completes
4. Compare the entries with the two groups
tcs.expected_result:
1. All 55 stations are receivable, with group H stronger than group L
2. The station list update starts
3. The station list holds the maximum number of entries
4. Every station of group H is on the list and no station of group L is on it, which places the selection on reception quality rather than on frequency order
tcs.design_method: 功能測試 (Functional based ; no specific technique)
